TEST FIXTURE Income Certificate. Department: TEST FIXTURE Revenue Department. Category: citizen. Official Sewa Setu service page: https://test.example.gov.in/site/service-apply/test-income-certificate.
source_title: TEST FIXTURE Income Certificate - Sewa Setu service page

text:
TEST FIXTURE Income Certificate - documents to be enclosed with the application (as labelled on the official page):
- Address Proof [Mandatory]
- Identity Proof [Mandatory]
- Salary Slip [Optional]
- Caste proof [Unspecified]
- Upload Scanned Copy of the Application Form [Conditional (incase of applying from PFC/CSC)]
source_title: TEST FIXTURE Income Certificate - Sewa Setu service page

text:
TEST FIXTURE Income Certificate - application steps:
1. Register and log in to the portal.
2. Fill in the application form and upload the documents.
3. Track the application with the reference number.
source_title: TEST FIXTURE Income Certificate - Sewa Setu service page

text:
TEST FIXTURE Income Certificate - fees and charges:
- User/Statutory charges -Rs. 30
- Printing charge (in case of any printing from PFC/CSC) -Rs. 10 Per Page
- Convenience fee- Rs. 10/-
- Subject to rules
source_title: TEST FIXTURE Income Certificate - Sewa Setu service page
